author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The Steam Controller is an absolute triumph when it comes to playing Steam games, but it's not the only controller out there.  Let's compare it to some of my favorite $50 options, the GameSir Cyclone 2 and 8BitDo Ultimate 2 Wireless.

Steam Controller: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/steamcontroller
GameSir Cyclone 2: https://amzn.to/4uLypnS
8BitDo Ultimate 2 Wireless: https://amzn.to/4uix880
